how_to_use: Moi lan review chay tools/review_run.py: cau 'auto' do may tra loi (PASS/FAIL + bang chung); cau 'image' agent PHAI mo anh close-up cua tung khoi va tra loi tung cau, ghi bang chung (toa do / ten linh kien). Khong duoc bo cau nao. Cau moi duoc THEM vao cuoi, khong xoa (knowledge-is-cumulative). Moi cau phai co rule/lesson goc. Thu tu giai doan (owner 2026-11-27): chi xet cac cau stage='finish' (silkscreen, nhan) SAU KHI moi cau stage='place_route' da PASS; truoc do chung la DEFERRED.

questions.q: DRC co 0 loi (clearance, hole, edge, courtyard)?
Khong con net ho (airwire)?
Moi tai nguon nhan dong theo thu tu nguon -> TVS -> bulk -> tai, tu decap truoc chan IC?
Moi tu decap cach chan no phuc vu <= 2.0 mm (mep pad - mep pad), toi da 4.0 mm?
Be rong nguon khong no ra doc duong (doan o pad nguon rong nhat)?
Khong via nao trong/sat pad SMD (< 0.2 mm sai, < 0.25 mm can xem)?
Khong track nao chay doc hang chan cua linh kien khac?
Moi doan nhin thay duoc deu 0/45/90 do?

rules: owner: khong di nguon duoi than IC
questions.q: Khong track nguon nao chay duoi than IC?
GND la zone solid ca 2 lop, khong con doan day GND?
Cap USB D+/D- khong co via; neu co thi da co chung minh bat buoc (L63)?
Moi cho doi lop cua net nguon co du via theo dong (>= 2 cho nhanh tai that; 1 chap nhan cho chan cam bien/ESD khong mang dong)?
Chi so gon (sat chan, duoi than IC, vao chan tu phia than, via/net) nam trong khoang ref? (gap khuc/10mm chi de tham khao: ban owner sua co bend cao hon do cap vi sai doi xung va bus deu)
Net tin hieu nao > 2 via (dau hieu phai quay ve placement)?
Moi thay doi netlist tren board (setnet) da ghi SCHEMATIC_CHANGES.md va can sua schematic theo?
Moi via/track cach mep board >= min_copper_edge_clearance cua LUAT DU AN (khong tu dat nguong rieng)?
Khong co goc gap > 45 do giua 2 doan lien nhau (ke ca goc 'an' sau doan vat < 0.3 mm), tru vong cau D+/D- trong courtyard connector buoc pad 0.5 mm?
Moi linh kien co ky hieu IN tren silkscreen (khong nam o F.Fab/an), khong de len pad, via, chu khac, khong ra ngoai board?
Moi ky hieu nam gan linh kien CUA NO nhat (khong gan nham sang linh kien ben canh)?
Tung khoi (USB, nguon, MCU, tai) co cung vai tro + vi tri tuong doi voi khoi tuong ung trong ref khong? Lech o dau, co ly do khong?
Trunk nguon co di thang/chu L ngan nhat, TVS/tu nam TREN trunk (trunk qua tam pad), tai lay bang nhanh ngan?
Co duong nao vong/khep quanh chan hoac linh kien khac ma khong can (dau hieu dat sai linh kien)?
Moi tu decap: pad GND cua no co via/mat dong GND ngay canh (vong hoi ngan)?
Via nao co the bo neu doi/xoay mot linh kien? Da kiem kha thi hinh hoc chua (L63)?
Track tin hieu di duoi than connector/IC co ly do, khong cat ngang mat GND duoi cap USB?
Dong tin hieu va nguon chay mot chieu qua board, khoi dat theo do nhay, khong co khoi bi day ra xa khien day dai?
Silkscreen: nhan chan header/connector dung thu tu, ky hieu doc duoc, khong de len pad?
Nhin toan board nhu nguoi review khac: con cho nao xau ma cac cau tren chua hoi? (them cau moi vao ngan hang neu co)
Moi tu decap co via GND trong 1.5 mm quanh pad GND cua no?
Cap vi sai (USB D+/D-) co di thanh CAP: song song, khoang cach deu, fan-in/fan-out doi xung vao chan IC va connector?
Cac nhom day cung chuc nang (UART TX/RX, kenh LED, PWM) co di thanh BUS: khoang cach deu, cac diem gap thang hang?
Via khau GND co phu deu moi vung dong GND (moi dao, quanh IC, giua cac nhom day, doc mep), khong chi luoi thua?
Nhanh nguon co di vong ra ngoai (mep board) de nhuong cho cho chan IC, thay vi ep sat chan?
